PhobosAutoNav.intro: Asterel plug-in boards for the native Polaris navigation station. Fit them into the station’s module slots and use the shared Phobos flight hub; they are not floor fixtures and have no INSTALL tile. Working N1/N2 provide navigation, while N3 supplies independent fire controls. Removing a module can suspend the function that owns it. Regional offers extend through the current vanilla solar system; see [market coverage and the game's market pricing](solar-system-economy.md). Crew standing orders are opt-in; see [crew work, training and time-skips](crew-automation.md) for eligible work, approved stores, resource limits and resuming industrial and exterior work. Compact controls, unsaved settings and object selection are explained in the [control-panel guide](control-panel-guide.md). Ordinary flight, FCS and Combat support one secured tow; release it before terminal docking or industrial close work. FCS uses only the piloted ship’s weapons and requires a separate fire target. See [towing controls and limits](auto-nav-towing.md).

groups.title: N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module
groups.function: Navigation, approach and docking assistance. It can stop short of a destination or use a separate docking command.
groups.use: Fit a working board to Polaris, open its Phobos hub, select a ship, station or asteroid your sensors track, set arrival preferences and choose Fly, Dock or Approach & Dock as appropriate. Asteroids need a live track within 1,000 km and support Fly only; the default arrival stops inside native tether reach. Details and phobosnav sensors show each sensor's signal. If the track is too faint, Auto Nav switches on the fewest sensors that fix it, non-emitting first, warns you on the nav map and in the crew log, and later switches off only its own. Use Stop to release flight control. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Build at a supported table, buy from the listed dealers, or find an N1/N2/N3 board in eligible native module loot. Damaged finds need repair. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Warm standing.
groups.notes: Indefinite position holding is not promised. Sensor quality, braking room, fuel and native restrictions still apply. Docking resumes only after an explicit post-load Resume. Local obstacle avoidance uses tracked contacts, weak contacts within 100 km with extra clearance, and asteroid-field rocks; Auto Nav may switch on sensors to sharpen them, with a warning, and lost tracking requires Resume. Sensors are switched on only by explicit command. Explicit Undock & Depart / Undock & Continue prepare a 1 km hull-gap departure and require every crew member on the company roster aboard; missing or away crew block departure. See [departure and avoidance](auto-nav-departure.md).

groups.title: N2 Polaris Pursuit Module
groups.function: Includes navigation/docking and adds Rendezvous and Follow for moving contacts. With N3, explicit Combat matches the selected fire target while retaining the previous mission for Resume.
groups.use: Fit to Polaris and use the Pursuit page. Rendezvous approaches once; Follow maintains a distance band. Choosing another mode mid-flight asks first, then stops the current flight on the second press. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Build at a supported table, buy from the listed dealers, or find an N1/N2/N3 board in eligible native module loot. Damaged finds need repair. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Friendly standing.
groups.notes: N2 does not authorize firing; use N3 for that. Pursuit suspends on reload and cannot guarantee catching a faster ship. Local obstacle avoidance uses tracked contacts, weak contacts within 100 km with extra clearance, and asteroid-field rocks; Auto Nav may switch on sensors to sharpen them, with a warning, and lost tracking requires Resume. Explicit Undock & Depart / Undock & Continue prepare a 1 km hull-gap departure and require every crew member on the company roster aboard; missing or away crew block departure. See [departure and avoidance](auto-nav-departure.md).

groups.title: N3 Polaris Fire Control System
groups.function: Independent weapon observations, bounded offensive volleys and optional RCS aiming. It can operate without N1/N2.
groups.use: Fit to Polaris, open Fire, choose a target and use Weapon group to see installed weapons, including off or damaged ones. Left-click Volleys to increase, right-click to decrease (1–9, wrapping). Engage permits the chosen volleys. Cease Fire holds offensive fire; Return to ship controls releases it. Switching an FCS-held group asks for confirmation: the old group may resume the ship’s automatic firing and the new group enters Hold with aiming off. See the [Polaris controls](development/polaris-interface-refresh.md).
groups.find: Build at a supported table, buy from the listed dealers, or find an N1/N2/N3 board in eligible native module loot. Damaged finds need repair. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Friendly standing.
groups.notes: Firing permission is not restored from a save. N2 plus N3 combines Follow and firing; flight braking and clearance take priority over aiming.

groups.title: Electronics assembly offcuts
groups.function: Retained material left over when any N1/N2/N3 board is constructed.
groups.use: Keep, haul or offer to a compatible scrap buyer.
groups.find: Appears beside the new board at construction completion.
groups.notes: The name still mentions N1, but all three board recipes share this identity. It is not a small electronic-parts item and has no current refining recipe.

groups.title: Board residue
groups.function: Terminal remainder from dismantling any working or damaged N1/N2/N3 board.
groups.use: Treat as retained scrap cargo; reuse or repair a board before choosing irreversible dismantling.
groups.find: Produced by the Dismantle action on a board.
groups.notes: The N1-labelled identity is shared across all three models. It cannot be refined into electronics by a current Phobos recipe.

PhobosShipbreaker.intro: Rivetline machinery recovers material and casts rough industrial products. Asterel C1 provides optional central controls. Obtain loose equipment, place it through the indicated native INSTALL tab, supply electricity where required, and keep service approaches accessible. Local panels remain usable without C1. Receiving, processing and hot-furnace controls are separate permissions. Pending-equipment reloads include a bounded room-grid mitigation; see [evidence and limits](development/shipbreaker-room-load-mitigation.md). It cannot recover atmosphere already lost before saving. Regional offers extend through the current vanilla solar system; see [market coverage and the game's market pricing](solar-system-economy.md). Crew standing orders are opt-in; see [crew work, training and time-skips](crew-automation.md) for eligible work, approved stores, resource limits and resuming industrial and exterior work. Compact controls, unsaved settings and object selection are explained in the [control-panel guide](control-panel-guide.md). In selection fields, Locate opens a temporary marked ship view; Clear is a draft change that requires Apply. Pick on ship marks eligible objects and Escape restores the panel and view.

groups.title: D4 Dismantling Fixture
groups.function: Processes detached structural parts (ordinary walls of any make, floor grates, DuraWal, Whipple and aero panels, windows) into native scrap and parts; a wall also returns the identified residue packet, a lighter part a terminal reject.
groups.use: Install on cabin flooring and supply power. Put detached structural parts (ordinary walls of any make at 14 to 48 kg, floor grates, DuraWal, Whipple and aero panels, windows) in its Inventory, switch on Load feed by crew so crew keep it loaded from anywhere aboard, or use the G4/H4 intake; then enable processing once and the queue waits for more. Products appear in the normal machine inventory. To move ordinary products out automatically, choose a storage container on the Routing page and Start unloading to storage; see [storage outputs](automatic-material-routing.md#storage-outputs-for-ordinary-products). Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy loose or damaged equipment; it comes whole. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Install the loose machine with Install or through INSTALL > APPS. It is no longer built from assembly sections; saved sections convert automatically. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Friendly standing.
groups.notes: It does not cut attached hull walls. Doors, hatches, conduit, furniture and machinery are refused. Fresh wall jobs make identified R2 feed; older bound jobs retain their original mixed-residue output. Processing and storage unloading that were running carry on after a reload.

groups.title: G4 Exterior Grabber
groups.function: Receives detached wall panels and, when explicitly enabled, cuts supported captured walls for the existing D4 chain.
groups.use: Install the G4/H4/D4 assembly with all four backing walls intact. Manual loading and intake still work. For automatic reclamation, bind the exact G4 and N1/N2 console to an owned, unoccupied wreck, then choose Start reclamation. A mission that was running carries on after loading if its checks pass; Resume is required after lost authority or a failed check. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Friendly standing.
groups.notes: Requires Auto Nav and Framework; see the installation guide for current minimum versions. Cutting, feeding, release, outward retreat, traversal and recapture are sequenced. Cutting rejects its delivered electrical energy as heat through the D4 interior service area (at least 10 kPa and headroom below 40 C); this is authored gameplay cooling, not a simulated physical coolant circuit. Only empty, unstacked, undamaged ordinary walls of any make (14 to 48 kg) with retained floors/supports qualify. Target pressure must be at most 0.1 kPa. Stop retains the capture; Release is separate. Floors, other equipment, cargo and final supports remain.

groups.title: H4 Sealed Hull Chute
groups.function: Connects the exterior grabber and interior processor across intact structural flooring.
groups.use: Install in the documented G4 → H4 → D4 arrangement; align and power the associated equipment.
groups.find: Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Warm standing.
groups.notes: Backing walls remain the pressure barrier. The chute is not an open portal, pressure-cycling airlock or arbitrary conveyor network.

groups.title: C2 Residue Collector
groups.function: A finite physical cargo receiver for explicitly paired industrial outputs.
groups.use: Install on two structural floor tiles with a clear two-tile service walkway, or at the hull with the existing wall supports. Lay a conveyor belt on or beside it to the machine, or place the machine within one tile; then link the required machine/output port, select an exact filter and enable receiving. For Agriculture's optional Recycler capture, align the full two-tile pocket against the Recycler with the service side facing away; enable collection from the Recycler panel. Empty Inventory when full. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Warm standing.
groups.notes: Full collectors block transfer; cargo stays at the sender. It does not jettison material or reduce ship mass. Furnace products need their explicit filter.

groups.title: R4 Scrap Reclaimer
groups.function: Reclaims identified R2 panel residue into steel, aluminium and terminal rejects.
groups.use: Supply power and adequate cabin atmosphere, put exact R2 feed in its Inventory, switch on Load feed by crew or enable a paired intake, then start processing. Set residue, aluminium and steel storage outputs independently; see [storage outputs](automatic-material-routing.md#storage-outputs-for-ordinary-products). Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy machinery; it comes whole. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Install the loose machine with Install or through INSTALL > APPS. It is no longer built from assembly sections; saved sections convert automatically. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Friendly standing.
groups.notes: Legacy mixed residue and terminal rejects are not valid feed. The machine puts heat into cabin gas and, like every Phobos machine, does not work in vacuum. Receiving, processing and storage unloading that were running carry on after a reload.

groups.title: F6 Electric Furnace
groups.function: Electrically heats an exact aluminium charge to cast a rough machinery housing.
groups.use: Build or buy the furnace, install it with a compatible cooling endpoint and power. Use the local panel to load (or Load feed by crew for single aluminium pieces), seal, heat and cast, then cool, equalize and release products. Follow the complete cycle guide, or choose [Repeat batches](furnace-player-guide.md#repeat-batches) to seal, run, equalize and release each full charge automatically. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy machinery; it comes whole. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Install the loose machine with Install or through INSTALL > APPS. It is no longer built from assembly sections; saved sections convert automatically. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Trusted standing.
groups.notes: Requires finite cooling and a valid gas receiver. Direct coupling can transfer heat without power; piped circulation requires pump electricity. Automatic material receipt never authorizes Seal, Start or Release; only an explicitly started repeat run does, and it pauses on any manoeuvre, interruption, manual control or reload. Hot machinery retains heat across saves.

groups.title: F6-R Exterior Radiator
groups.function: Rejects furnace heat through a finite exterior cooling assembly.
groups.use: Install in the documented exterior location and pair with the F6. Direct coupling or the optional dedicated coolant route is supported.
groups.find: Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Warm standing.
groups.notes: One cooling endpoint per furnace. Direct coupling is passive; a remote piped installation needs powered circulation. A disconnected exposed radiator still rejects heat already in its own store. It is not an unlimited heat sink; do not switch pairs or modes while hot. If older saves left cargo inside, choose Recover stored cargo while beside the unit and move the items out. New deposits are blocked. The right-click Maintenance sheet identifies contents, coolant, heat and paired-equipment restrictions. Actual work lots remain reserved until their native job finishes or is cancelled. It can serve one ML-2 mining laser that touches it in place of a furnace.

groups.title: F6-P Thermal Exhaust Port
groups.function: A sealed deck fitting representing the alternative underside radiator assembly.
groups.use: Install at the documented furnace-side cooling attachment, rotated with the F6, and select its cooling pairing.
groups.find: Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Warm standing.
groups.notes: The small head represents a complete finite assembly. It keeps the native floor sealed and does not vent cabin air or create a lower deck. If older saves left cargo inside, choose Recover stored cargo while beside the unit and move the items out. New deposits are blocked. The right-click Maintenance sheet identifies contents, coolant, heat and paired-equipment restrictions. Actual work lots remain reserved until their native job finishes or is cancelled.

groups.title: F6-C Sealed Coolant Conduit
groups.function: Provides the separate coolant route between the F6 and a remote F6-R.
groups.use: Place contiguous segments through HVAC from under or right beside the furnace to the radiator's mounting wall or the tiles just inside it, and select Piped cooling while cool and empty. Use the furnace’s checked routing controls. With serviced coolant the pump fills it, about 0.33 kg a tile; to take it up, right-click it and choose Drain line into canister with a Framework drain canister carried or within two tiles.
groups.find: Buy ordinary supply/fixer/Halvorson stock or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: This is not electrical cable or irrigation pipe. Legacy sealed operation and optional finite coolant servicing have different requirements: since Shipbreaker 0.58.0 a serviced conduit holds its own coolant and cannot be taken up until drained, while a sealed-assembly conduit holds nothing. Damaged forms retain separate identities even when the display name lacks a damage suffix. Loose intact and damaged sections support storage stacks, separately by identity; installed segments remain individual fixtures. Split off a section when an action requires an individual item.

groups.title: C1 Industrial Control Console
groups.function: Provides central status and checked commands for installed industrial equipment on its own ship, with optional Agriculture integration.
groups.use: Install, power and use the seated console. Select a machine; filter by name, type or attention state and issue the available service commands. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Warm standing.
groups.notes: Physical cargo access and maintenance remain local. Docked, moored and towed ships are separate scopes; C1 is not required for autonomous processing.

groups.title: Y2, Y3 and Y4 Material Bins
groups.function: Sealed, unpowered stores for mined material: ore, loose regolith, gangue, water and methane ice, ice gangue and mined chunks such as clay hydrates. The 2 x 2 Y2 has a 4 x 4 grid, the 3 x 3 Y3 a 6 x 6 grid and the 4 x 4 Y4 an 8 x 8 grid; ore stacks six to a cell, so a Y2 holds about a tonne of ore. Every block keeps its own identity and mass.
groups.use: Install through FURN like the game's Storage Bay, then open its Inventory and put mined material in. Crew treat an installed bin as an ordinary unlocked container: Load feed by crew can fetch from it (choose it, or leave the ship-wide search on) and a machine's crew order can send gangue and other mined products into it. A T2, V4, LC-3, SA-3 or fermenter-still can also take its feed straight from a bin that touches it or is joined to it by conveyor belt: choose the bin under Take feed from on the machine's panel. It takes nothing but mined material. See [the bin guide](shipbreaker-material-bins.md).
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below. No fabrication recipe. The Y2 may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; the Y3 and Y4 are too big to turn up in salvage. See the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Warm standing.
groups.notes: Uninstalling carries the contents with the loose bin, as the game's own Storage Bay does, so a full bin is very heavy. Dismantle is refused until the bin is empty. The D4 and R4 storage outputs do not list bins, because bins refuse their scrap products.

groups.title: T2 Ice Thaw Unit
groups.function: Thaws one block of the game's water ice (24.7 kg) at a time into 22.7 kg of process water for a linked silo or R3 reservoir plus one 2 kg gangue packet in its tray. It also breaks down methane ice (24.84 kg): 19.89 kg of water to the silo and 2.95 kg of methane to a linked Phobos Manufacturing methane store, never into the air.
groups.use: Install through APPS within one tile of the vessel, connect power, choose Deliver water to on its panel or C1, put water ice in its Inventory (it takes one block at a time from there) or switch on Load feed by crew, then Start / resume thawing. 6 kW for 40 minutes a block of water ice, 50 minutes for methane ice; part of it warms the room. For methane ice also choose Send methane to on the panel (it appears once a methane store is within one tile). See [the silo guide](shipbreaker-bulk-silos.md).
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below. No fabrication recipe. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Warm standing.
groups.notes: Gangue and stacked blocks are refused; methane ice waits until a methane store is linked, and crew only bring it once one is. Nothing warms until the linked vessel has room for a whole block; a hot or airless room makes it wait. A thaw that was running carries on after a reload. Empty the two-cell gangue tray by hand or a crew output store. The game's methane ice is valued at 100 cr with Shipbreaker loaded (owner decision, 1 October 2026), so a thawed block gives about twice its worth in water and methane; blocks already aboard take the price when a save loads.

groups.title: ML-2 Mining Laser
groups.function: A hull-mounted laser head that works the one ship moored to yours inside a 60 degree arc, 24 tiles deep. On a tethered asteroid it breaks rock walls, ice walls and cores with the game's own mining damage, so the game decides what falls out. On a hull the G4 has captured it cuts ordinary wall panels loose. It collects nothing: the crew fetch what falls.
groups.use: Install through APPS on the outside of the hull against two sound hull walls, connect power, and keep at least 10 kPa of air in the room behind it, or link an F6-R or F6-P radiator to take its heat. Its Settings page can queue the game's own Haul jobs for what it frees and Mine jobs for deposits it opens; both start off. Tether an asteroid or capture a hull with the G4, choose Set to cut on its panel or the C1, then Start / resume cutting. 24 kW while cutting, about 3.6 kW of it warming the room behind the mount (a quarter of its waste heat, by the machine heat setting); it waits while that room is near 40 C. A rock wall takes 45 s and 0.3 kWh, a wall panel 60 s and 0.4 kWh. Optionally fit an F6-R radiator or F6-P port touching it and choose it under Cooling: the heat then goes there, and Power: High (48 kW) halves each cut's time. See [the mining laser guide](shipbreaker-mining-laser.md).
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below. No fabrication recipe. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Friendly standing.
groups.notes: It only reaches a ship moored to yours, and exactly one. It never fires through its own ship, near the mooring anchors or while anyone stands within a tile of the beam. Opened ore deposits stay a crew job, and bare rock floor, ice floor and rubble are left because they only give gangue. Cutting that was under way starts again after a reload, through the same checks as Start. The firing animation and beam are drawn only. A cooling assembly serves one furnace or one laser; pairing needs a paused laser and an assembly at 50 C or below.

groups.title: D4-S assembly section
groups.function: A retired assembly section from the old way of building the D4. It does nothing on its own.
groups.use: None: the D4 now comes whole. Aboard your own ship, any two of these become one whole loose D4 by themselves; a leftover goes back to its recipe's scrap and parts on the deck where it lay. See [installing machines](section-assembly-and-maintenance.md).
groups.find: No longer made, sold or found since Shipbreaker 0.60.0. Only copies already in a save remain, and they convert once aboard your own ship.
groups.notes: A section build site with every section delivered can still be finished; one still waiting for sections is cancelled and its sections convert. Sections in a trader's stock or on another ship are left alone until they come aboard. The D4's installation site uses this section's artwork as its early stage.

groups.title: R4-S assembly section
groups.function: A retired assembly section from the old way of building the R4. It does nothing on its own.
groups.use: None: the R4 now comes whole. Aboard your own ship, any two of these become one whole loose R4 by themselves; a leftover goes back to its recipe's scrap and parts on the deck where it lay. See [installing machines](section-assembly-and-maintenance.md).
groups.find: No longer made, sold or found since Shipbreaker 0.60.0. Only copies already in a save remain, and they convert once aboard your own ship.
groups.notes: A section build site with every section delivered can still be finished; one still waiting for sections is cancelled and its sections convert. Sections in a trader's stock or on another ship are left alone until they come aboard. The R4's installation site uses this section's artwork as its early stage.

groups.title: F6-S furnace assembly section
groups.function: A retired assembly section from the old way of building the F6. It does nothing on its own.
groups.use: None: the F6 now comes whole. Aboard your own ship, any three of these become one whole loose F6 by themselves; a leftover goes back to its recipe's scrap and parts on the deck where it lay. See [installing machines](section-assembly-and-maintenance.md).
groups.find: No longer made, sold or found since Shipbreaker 0.60.0. Only copies already in a save remain, and they convert once aboard your own ship.
groups.notes: A section build site with every section delivered can still be finished; one still waiting for sections is cancelled and its sections convert. Sections in a trader's stock or on another ship are left alone until they come aboard. The F6 installation site has its own 6 x 6 stage artwork; this 4 x 4 section image stays on the retired item.

groups.title: Rough aluminium machinery housing
groups.function: The released rough casting from the first F6 recipe.
groups.use: Finish it through the table recipe, or choose explicit aluminium recovery if you no longer need it.
groups.find: Released from a completed and safely cooled F6 casting batch.
groups.notes: Its old recipe identity is preserved; it is not a finished Manufacturing heat sink.

groups.title: Finished aluminium machinery housing
groups.function: A finished aluminium casting. Since Shipbreaker 0.60.0 it has no construction use: the D4-S and R4-S section recipes that took one are retired.
groups.use: Cut it back into aluminium scrap with the explicit recovery recipe, at a loss. For useful castings choose the F6 ingot recipes instead.
groups.find: Finish a rough F6 housing at a supported table.
groups.notes: This is cargo, not a fixture. Recovery preserves mass but yields much less base value than the whole housing.

groups.title: Terminal aluminium melt remainder
groups.function: Retained casting-process remainder.
groups.use: Keep as physical waste or offer to a compatible buyer.
groups.find: Appears with released F6 casting products.
groups.notes: No current remelting or reclaimer recipe accepts it; its small value is not a recovery yield.

groups.title: Aluminium ingot
groups.function: A 4 kg cast aluminium ingot: the raw stock for coming Phobos Manufacturing machining.
groups.use: Choose the aluminium-ingots recipe on the F6 (panel, C1 or F3) and run a twenty-scrap charge: four ingots, three scrap gates and one melt remainder are released. Keep ingots as stock, sell them as metals, or cut one back into four aluminium scraps at a table (Recover aluminium from ingot). See [F6 recipes](furnace-player-guide.md#recipes-housings-and-ingots).
groups.find: Released from a completed and cooled F6 aluminium-ingot charge, or bought as ordinary supply from the sellers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Stacks to ten. Recovery to scrap loses value; the ingot is worth more than the four scraps it holds. No machine consumes ingots until Manufacturing arrives.

groups.title: Steel ingot
groups.function: A 4 kg cast steel ingot from the F6 steel charge: the raw stock for coming Phobos Manufacturing machining.
groups.use: Choose the steel-ingots recipe on the F6 and load twenty 1 kg steel scraps; the hotter, longer cycle releases four ingots, three steel scrap gates and one steel melt remainder. Keep, sell, or cut one back into four steel scraps at a table (Recover steel from ingot). See [F6 recipes](furnace-player-guide.md#recipes-housings-and-ingots).
groups.find: Released from a completed and cooled F6 steel-ingot charge, or bought as ordinary supply from the sellers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Stacks to ten. Recovery to scrap loses value. The steel cycle needs well over half again the energy of an aluminium cycle through the same cooling assembly.

groups.title: Terminal steel melt remainder
groups.function: Retained steel casting-process remainder.
groups.use: Keep as physical waste or offer to a compatible buyer.
groups.find: Appears with released F6 steel-ingot products.
groups.notes: No remelting or reclaimer recipe accepts it; its small value is not a recovery yield. Distinct from the aluminium melt remainder.

groups.title: Identified Panel Residue R2
groups.function: Characterized gameplay feed for the R4.
groups.use: Load into R4 feed or transfer through an explicitly enabled route.
groups.find: Fresh revision-2 D4 wall jobs.
groups.notes: The authored result is steel, aluminium and terminal R2 rejects. It is not a measured chemical assay.

groups.title: Mixed Panel Residue — legacy
groups.function: Unclassified residue preserved from older D4 jobs and saves.
groups.use: Retain or move with supported collectors; do not substitute it for identified R2 feed.
groups.find: Existing cargo or completion of a job bound to the historical output contract.
groups.notes: No conversion to R2 and no R4 recycling; saving or updating does not reclassify it.

groups.title: Terminal Panel Rejects R2
groups.function: The nonrecoverable remainder of the R4 process.
groups.use: Store, haul or sell where accepted.
groups.find: Completing an R4 batch of identified panel residue.
groups.notes: Cannot be fed back through R4 to roll for more metals.

groups.title: Floor Grate Rejects R1
groups.function: The terminal remainder of a floor grate after the D4 takes its steel, aluminium and fittings, one kilogram a unit.
groups.use: Store, haul or sell where accepted. Units stack to ten.
groups.find: Completing a D4 batch of any floor grate make.
groups.notes: No further recipe; never re-processed. Leaves through the D4 storage output or by hand.

groups.title: DuraWal Rejects R1
groups.function: The 9.6 kg laminated remainder of a DuraWal interior wall.
groups.use: Store, haul or sell where accepted.
groups.find: Completing a D4 batch of a DuraWal interior wall.
groups.notes: No further recipe; never re-processed.

groups.title: Window Rejects R1
groups.function: The 6 kg glazing-and-seals remainder of a window panel.
groups.use: Store, haul or sell where accepted.
groups.find: Completing a D4 batch of a window panel.
groups.notes: The game has no glass item to recover. No further recipe.

groups.title: Whipple Rejects R1
groups.function: The 1.5 kg mesh-and-bonding remainder of a Whipple shielding panel.
groups.use: Store, haul or sell where accepted.
groups.find: Completing a D4 batch of a Whipple shielding panel.
groups.notes: No further recipe; never re-processed.

groups.title: Aero Panel Rejects R1
groups.function: The 2.1 kg composite core remainder of an aerodynamic panel.
groups.use: Store, haul or sell where accepted.
groups.find: Completing a D4 batch of an aerodynamic panel.
groups.notes: No further recipe; never re-processed.

groups.title: Thermal Service Fluid Charge
groups.function: Fresh fictional industrial coolant for optional finite F6 servicing.
groups.use: In cool, idle piped mode enable finite servicing, place charges in Products and load locally. The furnace keeps 5 kg and its pump sends the rest into the conduit, about 0.33 kg a tile, so keep loading until the status reads Conduit full. Prime before operating.
groups.find: Ordinary supply, fixer or Halvorson stock as listed below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Not drinking water, irrigation feed or ammonia. The legacy sealed cooling mode does not require these charges. Fresh thermal service fluid charges support storage stacks of three. Split off one before furnace filling; retained coolant remains individual.

groups.title: Retained Thermal Service Fluid
groups.function: Physically retained fluid drained or captured from the optional coolant service.
groups.use: Recover through local coolant-drain controls and store the resulting cargo.
groups.find: F6 finite coolant draining and captured-loss recovery.
groups.notes: Live mass may differ from the template below. No current conversion back to a fresh service charge or potable water is provided.

groups.title: Retained Coolant Conduit Waste
groups.function: Terminal material left after dismantling F6-C.
groups.use: Keep as waste cargo or trade where accepted.
groups.find: Dismantling an intact or damaged F6-C segment.
groups.notes: It is not a fresh pipe or a coolant charge.

groups.title: Built-in feed compartments
groups.function: Named child inventories built into D4, R4, F6 and T2. They are not separate products.
groups.use: A started D4, R4 or T2 fills its compartment from the machine's own Inventory, one unit at a time; the F6's opens from its Control Panel. Each takes only its accepted structural parts (ordinary walls of any make, floor grates, DuraWal, Whipple and aero panels, windows), R2 residue, single 1 kg pieces of the metal the selected furnace recipe takes, or single blocks of water ice. Load feed by crew fills it too.
groups.find: Shown as feed/chamber inventory within their owning machine.
groups.notes: No purchase, INSTALL, repair, Restore or standalone salvage contract. Empty-machine checks include these compartments.

PhobosAgriculture.intro: Verdemorrow equipment grows potatoes and lettuce, cooks potato portions and manages finite irrigation. These are authored, accelerated gameplay systems. Crop yields and simplified nutrient/treatment chemistry are not research results. The linked research guide attributes the supporting work separately; none of the pricing or yield balance implies NASA/ESA endorsement. See [research and attribution](development/agriculture-research.md). Regional offers extend through the current vanilla solar system; see [market coverage and the game's market pricing](solar-system-economy.md). Crew standing orders are opt-in; see [crew work, training and time-skips](crew-automation.md) for eligible work, approved stores, resource limits and resuming industrial and exterior work. Compact controls, unsaved settings and object selection are explained in the [control-panel guide](control-panel-guide.md). In selection fields, Locate opens a temporary marked ship view; Clear is a draft change that requires Apply. Pick on ship marks eligible objects and Escape restores the panel and view.

groups.title: Firstlight-4 Cultivation Rack
groups.function: Grows one potato, food-lettuce or lettuce-seed cohort across four visual trays.
groups.use: Install and power the rack, load irrigation and nutrients, then perform Plant. Keep cabin conditions suitable and Harvest when ready. In a room too hot for the crop, Mist to cool crop holds it up to 4 C below the room for about 0.15 kg of water an hour per degree, and halves the heat damage beyond that; it also cools the room a little. Remove output cargo before replanting. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy equipment or build at a supported table; used/refurbished/damaged offers are listed below. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Warm standing.
groups.notes: Four trays are one crop batch. Food lettuce does not return seeds; choose the dedicated seed cycle. The local panel shows inventory, stress and progress.

groups.title: Hearth-2 Galley Cooker
groups.function: Cooks a raw potato portion into edible prepared food.
groups.use: Install, power, place raw potatoes in its Inventory and Start. Collect the cooked portion when complete. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy equipment or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Warm standing.
groups.notes: Its counter and stove artwork are one machine. Each job binds a particular raw portion; replacing it does not transfer progress.

groups.title: Groundwork W2 Water Supply Unit
groups.function: Stores water and nutrients and feeds both to its linked racks; also treats recorded process solution.
groups.use: Install and power W2, load water locally, link its racks and Start. Put any Groundwork nutrients in its Inventory, or set a nutrient hopper within one tile: it takes them by itself and feeds them with the water, recirculating a full rack's water when needed. Nothing is chosen, paused or unlinked. Use treatment controls for recorded drainage and a cartridge. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements. A drain canister of water put in its inventory pours into its reservoir.
groups.find: Buy supply/fixer/Halvorson stock or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Warm standing.
groups.notes: One nutrient for every crop since Agriculture 0.55.0: it keeps each rack at 0.1 kg, up to 10 g with each kilogram of water moved. Feeds mixed by earlier versions convert by themselves into water and nutrients. Several W2s may share one irrigation pipe; a W2 within one tile of its rack feeds it without the pipe. Receiving and pumping that were running carry on after a reload. Optional [Valtora’s Ship’s Water](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3757331189) integration is version-scoped and protects crew reserves; manual input remains available.

groups.title: Groundwork Irrigation Conduit
groups.function: Carries irrigation water, and the nutrients fed with it, between W2 and paired racks.
groups.use: Place contiguous segments in MISC from under or right beside the W2 to under or right beside each rack (any side), then use Pair/Receive controls; a W2 within one tile of a rack needs no pipe. A running W2 fills it first, about 0.2 kg of water a tile; to take it up, right-click it and choose Drain line into canister with a Framework drain canister carried or within two tiles.
groups.find: Buy stock, build at a supported table, or find a loose segment in eligible locked-crate contents. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Separate from electricity and F6 coolant. Since Agriculture 0.33.0 each tile holds its own water and cannot be taken up until drained; feed left in it by a version before 0.55.0 is flushed into the W2 when it next runs, or drains as before; a line parcel saved by an earlier version is delivered into its rack on the next powered run. Loose intact and damaged sections support storage stacks, separately by identity; installed segments remain individual fixtures. Split off a section when an action requires an individual item.

groups.title: Continuance Seed Potato
groups.function: Planting stock for a potato crop.
groups.use: Place one in the rack and choose Plant potato after loading water and nutrients.
groups.find: Buy stock, find eligible fridge/crate loot, or retain stock from a potato harvest. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: This is the sprouted planting item, not a raw edible portion. Split off one seed potato or seed packet before manual planting; an intact stack is not a planting input. Crew source hauling can deliver individual units from stacks.

groups.title: Continuance Lettuce Seeds
groups.function: Planting stock for either lettuce cycle.
groups.use: Load one packet, then choose food lettuce or the separate lettuce-for-seed cycle.
groups.find: Buy stock, find eligible fridge/crate loot, or harvest a completed lettuce-seed cohort. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Food-lettuce harvest gives leaves, not replacement seed packets. Split off one seed potato or seed packet before manual planting; an intact stack is not a planting input. Crew source hauling can deliver individual units from stacks.

groups.title: Continuance Seed Wheat
groups.function: Planting stock for a dwarf wheat crop: one 50 g packet sows one rack.
groups.use: Place one in the rack and choose Plant seed wheat after loading water and nutrients.
groups.find: Buy stock, find eligible fridge or crate loot, or keep the packet each wheat harvest gives back. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: A healthy harvest returns one packet, so a wheat rack restocks its own seed. Split one packet off a stack before planting by hand; crew orders take single units.

groups.title: Continuance Tomato Seeds
groups.function: Planting stock for a dwarf tomato crop: one 5 g packet sows one rack.
groups.use: Place one in the rack and choose Plant tomato seeds after loading water and nutrients.
groups.find: Buy stock, find eligible fridge or crate loot, or keep the packet the final tomato harvest saves from the fruit. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Picks do not return seed; only the final harvest does. Split one packet off a stack before planting by hand; crew orders take single units.

groups.title: Continuance Soybean Seeds
groups.function: Planting stock for a soybean crop: one 30 g packet sows one rack.
groups.use: Place one in the rack and choose Plant soybean seeds after loading water and nutrients.
groups.find: Buy stock, find eligible fridge or crate loot, or keep the packet each soybean harvest gives back. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: A healthy harvest returns one packet, so a soybean rack restocks its own seed.

groups.title: Groundwork Formulated Crop Nutrients
groups.function: Dry finite nutrient input.
groups.use: Put packets in the rack and choose Load nutrients, or put them in a W2's Inventory: the W2 takes them by itself and feeds its racks. One nutrient suits every crop. No Repair or Restore.
groups.find: Buy supplies or find eligible locked-crate loot. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Not fertilizer produced from arbitrary trash; unused loaded nutrients remain finite stored stock. Storage stacks retain individual packets and charge records. Split off one packet before manual loading, W2 dosing or B2 formulation; an intact stack is not a processing input. Crew source hauling can deliver individual units from stacks. Stacking does not replenish partially used packets.

groups.title: Groundwork Irrigation Charge
groups.function: A sealed root-water input commodity.
groups.use: Place in the rack or W2 and use Load irrigation charge with enough free reservoir space.
groups.find: Buy supplies or find eligible locked-crate loot. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Not a drinkable ration. Native water rations are an alternative input, not a conversion output. Irrigation charges support storage stacks of three. Split off one before manual water loading; per-charge quantity is unchanged.

groups.title: Raw Potatoes
groups.function: Uncooked potato harvest portions.
groups.use: Move to Hearth-2 and Start cooking.
groups.find: Harvest potatoes or find eligible fridge contents. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: The current raw item has no Eat action; use the cooker. It is not a seed potato. Raw potato portions support storage stacks. Separate one portion before placing it in the cooker; a whole stack is not a cooker input. Each portion retains its original mass.

groups.title: Hearth Cooked Potatoes
groups.function: Prepared crew food.
groups.use: Collect from Hearth-2 and use the Eat action.
groups.find: Cook raw potatoes or find eligible fridge loot. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Food effects are values chosen for gameplay. Portions support storage stacks; mass and food effects remain per individual portion.

groups.title: Lettuce
groups.function: Edible leaves from the food-lettuce crop.
groups.use: Harvest, collect and eat through the usual food actions.
groups.find: Harvest food lettuce or find eligible fridge loot. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Not seed stock. Growing lettuce for seed produces no edible leaves. Portions support storage stacks; mass and food effects remain per individual portion.

groups.title: Wheat Grain
groups.function: Dry grain from the wheat crop: one 0.4 kg portion a harvest.
groups.use: Bake it in the Hearth-2 with a water ration into flatbread. It is not eaten as it is.
groups.find: Harvest dwarf wheat, or find eligible fridge loot. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Grain keeps, and a wheat harvest leaves most of the plant as straw residue for the B2 bench. Growth times and yields are authored gameplay balance in the ratios NASA's crop chamber found; see docs/development/agriculture-crop-expansion.md.

groups.title: Hearth Flatbread
groups.function: Prepared crew food: one loaf of baked wheat.
groups.use: Put a grain portion and a water ration in the Hearth-2 and choose Start; collect the loaf and use the Eat action.
groups.find: Bake it from wheat grain, buy it at the food carts, or find eligible fridge loot. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Food effects follow the game's own prepared meal. Baking moisture loss is not modelled, so the loaf weighs its grain plus its water. Portions support storage stacks; mass and food effects remain per loaf.

groups.title: Tomatoes
groups.function: Fresh fruit from the tomato crop, eaten as it is.
groups.use: Pick a ripe plant with Pick ripe fruit (up to three times) or harvest it, collect the portions and use the Eat action.
groups.find: Grow tomatoes, or find eligible fridge loot. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: A light food like lettuce. A ripe plant can be picked three times, three portions each, and regrows what was picked in about ten hours at full health; the final harvest takes the rest. Growth times and yields are authored gameplay balance in the ratios NASA's crop chamber found; see docs/development/agriculture-crop-expansion.md.

groups.title: Soybeans
groups.function: Dry beans from the soybean crop: one 0.25 kg portion a harvest.
groups.use: Cook them in the Hearth-2 with a water ration into soybean stew. They are not eaten as they are.
groups.find: Harvest soybeans, or find eligible fridge loot. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Beans keep, and a soybean harvest leaves most of the plant as straw residue for the B2 bench. Growth times and yields are authored gameplay balance in the ratios NASA's crop chamber found; see docs/development/agriculture-crop-expansion.md.

groups.title: Hearth Soybean Stew
groups.function: Prepared crew food: a bowl of cooked soybeans.
groups.use: Put a soybean portion and a water ration in the Hearth-2 and choose Start; collect the bowl and use the Eat action.
groups.find: Cook it from soybeans, buy it at the food carts, or find eligible fridge loot. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Food effects are values chosen for gameplay: heavy and satisfying. Steam loss is not modelled, so the bowl weighs its beans plus its water. Portions support storage stacks; mass and food effects remain per bowl.

groups.title: Continuance Flax Seed
groups.function: Planting stock for a fibre flax crop: one 10 g packet of linseed sows one rack.
groups.use: Place one in the rack and choose Sow flax seed after loading water and nutrients.
groups.find: Buy stock, find eligible crate loot, or keep the packet each flax harvest gives back. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: A healthy harvest returns one packet, so a flax rack restocks its own seed. Not food; linseed oil is not in this version.

groups.title: Flax Straw
groups.function: A 0.25 kg bundle of pulled, retted flax stems: four from each flax harvest.
groups.use: Scutch it at a Groundwork B2 (Prepare flax scutching, then Start) for two of the game's clean scrap cloth and 0.2 kg of shives for the straw press.
groups.find: Harvest fibre flax. Never sold or found.
groups.notes: Clean scrap cloth is the game's own repair and buffing supply. The 20% cloth yield sits within published flax scutching and hackling yields; the bundle's make-up is authored.

groups.title: Continuance Sugar Beet Seed
groups.function: Planting stock for a sugar beet crop: one 20 g packet sows one rack.
groups.use: Place one in the rack and choose Sow sugar beet seed after loading water and nutrients.
groups.find: Buy stock, find eligible crate loot, or keep the packet each beet harvest gives back. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: A healthy harvest returns one packet, so a beet rack restocks its own seed.

groups.title: Sugar Beet
groups.function: A 0.5 kg sugar beet root: nine from each beet harvest.
groups.use: Extract its sugar at a Groundwork B2 (Prepare sugar extraction, then Start) for a 70 g sugar packet and pulp for the straw press.
groups.find: Harvest sugar beet. Never sold or found.
groups.notes: Authored as 75% water and 17% sucrose, within published sugar beet figures. A Phobos Manufacturing fermenter for beets is planned.

groups.title: Beet Sugar
groups.function: A 70 g packet of white sugar from the B2.
groups.use: Eat it for a little hunger relief, or keep it for a fermenter.
groups.find: Extract it from sugar beets at a B2. Never sold or found.
groups.notes: Food effects are values chosen for gameplay: a small food, not a meal.

groups.title: Crop Residue
groups.function: Retained nonfood crop biomass, including growth losses and rounding.
groups.use: Remove it from rack storage as physical waste.
groups.find: Old harvests and cohorts planted before recovery recording.
groups.notes: Legacy unrecorded variable-mass residue. B2 preserves this identity and cannot infer nutrients from it.

groups.title: Agricultural Process Solution — unrecorded
groups.function: Legacy or otherwise uncharacterized retained process liquid.
groups.use: Keep and haul it as nonpotable retained cargo.
groups.find: Older crop/process outputs and preserved saves.
groups.notes: No recorded composition: W2 treatment must not infer one or silently upgrade this item.

groups.title: Recorded Process Solution
groups.function: Drainage with saved water/nutrient quantities that W2 can validate.
groups.use: Place alongside a usable treatment cartridge in W2; queue drainage treatment, then Start and provide power/output space.
groups.find: New recorded drainage and retained solution recovery.
groups.notes: Live mass/composition comes from the saved batch. Recovery is partial, with terminal rejects, and never returns drinking water.

groups.title: Groundwork Treatment Cartridge
groups.function: Finite treatment medium used by W2.
groups.use: Place with recorded drainage and queue treatment. Keep returned part-used cartridges for later batches.
groups.find: Buy supplies or find eligible locked-crate loot. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: The table shows a full cartridge; remaining capacity controls live mass and price. Historical bound jobs may consume a whole cartridge. Cartridges support storage stacks of three separate objects. Split off one before treatment. Each retains its own remaining capacity; a batch must fit one cartridge, and stacking never pools or refills capacity.

groups.title: Retained Treatment Rejects
groups.function: Spent medium and unrecovered material from W2 treatment.
groups.use: Collect and retain as waste cargo.
groups.find: Completion of drainage treatment.
groups.notes: Actual packet mass varies; it cannot be treated again for another recovery roll.

groups.title: Agricultural Housing Waste
groups.function: Terminal housing remainders from equipment dismantling. Several different masses share this display name.
groups.use: Use the origin and mass below to identify the packet; keep or trade it as waste.
groups.find: Produced with recoverable materials by Dismantle.
groups.notes: Not construction stock, planting medium or R4 feed. The distinct identities must not be combined into a new salvage recipe.

groups.title: Groundwork B2 Workup Bench
groups.function: Recovers recorded crop nutrients and formulates finite W2 mixtures.
groups.use: Install through APPS, power, load a recorded residue packet, prepare recovery and Start. Then prepare recovered concentrate plus equal-mass makeup salts and Start. Leave output room. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy supply/fixer/Halvorson stock or construct at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Warm standing.
groups.notes: Each stage binds physical inputs and consumes power; a stage that was running carries on after a reload. Damaged hardware is repairable; consumable contents are not.

groups.title: Recorded Crop Residue
groups.function: Retained wet crop matter with a bounded saved nutrient allocation.
groups.use: Process at B2; empty or unrecorded nutrient budgets are not eligible.
groups.find: Harvest or clear a cohort planted from Agriculture 0.9.0 onward.
groups.notes: Actual mass and allocation vary. Old residue and old cohorts are not reassayed.

groups.title: Recovered Nutrient Concentrate
groups.function: Recovered nutrient concentrate. Add makeup salts at B2 before using it for plants.
groups.use: Formulate at B2 with equal-mass Groundwork makeup salts.
groups.find: B2 crop recovery only; a spawned unrecorded template is unusable.
groups.notes: Cannot feed plants directly. Saved composition must match physical mass.

groups.title: Groundwork Makeup Salts
groups.function: Supplement salts for mixing with recovered nutrient concentrate.
groups.use: Place at B2 with concentrate; retain returned partial packets.
groups.find: Buy supply/fixer/Halvorson stock. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Full packet values below; partial mass and value decrease. Cannot Repair or Restore; not a complete nutrient substitute. Storage stacks retain individual packets and charge records. Split off one packet before manual loading, W2 dosing or B2 formulation; an intact stack is not a processing input. Crew source hauling can deliver individual units from stacks. Stacking does not replenish partially used packets.

groups.title: Recovered Crop Nutrient Mixture
groups.function: Finished finite nutrient charge for W2 blending.
groups.use: Put it in a W2's Inventory. The W2 takes nutrients from it by itself while running and feeds its racks with the water.
groups.find: B2 formulation from recorded concentrate plus makeup salts.
groups.notes: No automatic packet substitution. Mass and value decrease with actual blending; cannot Repair or Restore. Template value is not a usable unrecorded charge.

groups.title: Spent Crop Biomass
groups.function: All residue material remaining after concentrate recovery.
groups.use: Load it into the B2 straw press (Agriculture 0.44.0 and later), or remove it as waste cargo.
groups.find: B2 recovery.
groups.notes: Variable mass includes water and unrecovered nutrients; no further nutrient recovery. Biomass made since 0.44.0 records its plant matter and can be pressed into straw bales.

groups.title: Straw Bale
groups.function: A dried 1 kg bale of pressed crop waste: 0.87 kg plant matter, 0.03 kg minerals and 0.10 kg water.
groups.use: Feed it to a Phobos Manufacturing V4: one bale with a linked oxygen store burns into carbon dioxide for a grow room; four char into one carbon stock.
groups.find: Made by the B2 straw press from recorded crop residue and spent biomass. Never sold or found.
groups.notes: Fixed composition so the V4 can take it by mass. Without Phobos Manufacturing 0.37.0 it has no use.

groups.title: Recycler Wet Rejects
groups.function: Measured wet remainder from an optionally attached Ship’s Water Recycler.
groups.use: Collect from a linked powered Phobos Residue Collector; remove full packets manually.
groups.find: Opt-in attachment with Ship’s Water 0.16.1 and Shipbreaker 0.20.0.
groups.notes: Maximum 13 kg per packet and 52 kg per collector. Uncharacterized water remainder; no B2 fertilizer recipe or industrial reclaimer route.

groups.title: Groundwork R3, R4 and R5 Agricultural Water Reservoirs
groups.function: Retired in Agriculture 0.31.0. The former agricultural water buffers (120 kg in the 3 x 3 R3, 235 kg in the 4 x 4 R4, 400 kg in the 5 x 5 R5) convert on load to Framework's Rivetline S3, S4 and S5 process water silos of the same footprint.
groups.use: Nothing to do: every saved reservoir, installed or loose, becomes the silo of its size when the game loads, in place, with its water, reserve, inventory and W2 link. Use the silo as before; its Control Panel is Framework's, and the reservoir crew work (load a charge, recover, drain, standing fill order) carries on there.
groups.find: No longer sold or found. The definitions stay only as conversion sources for jobs saved against a reservoir.
groups.notes: The conversion keeps the water record under the silo's names, carries wear and locks, and moves the saved mass by the difference in housing, so the converted silo weighs and is worth what a silo is. Downgrading afterwards is not supported.

groups.title: Groundwork E2, E3 and E4 Nutrient Hoppers
groups.function: Passive stores of formulated dry crop nutrients, kept as a kilogram record: 10 kg in the 2 x 2 E2, 25 kg in the 3 x 3 E3 and 48 kg in the 4 x 4 E4. A W2 within one tile stocks its nutrient store from one while running.
groups.use: Install through APPS within one tile of a W2. Fill it at a station refuelling kiosk under Bulk supplies (crop nutrients by the kilogram at 1,500 cr/kg). A W2 with no charge in its Inventory uses the hopper by itself; its Supplies page names the source. Crew work recovers trapped nutrients after repair and bags up to 500 g at a time into a bulk nutrient charge to empty it. See [the bulk storage guide](agriculture-bulk-storage.md).
groups.find: Empty loose hardware on the reservoir routes (Agriculture supply, fixer, Halvorson and supported regional merchants), finite lots of four. No fabrication recipe. The E2 may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; the E3 and E4 never do. See the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Warm standing.
groups.notes: Damage isolates the nutrients in a finite catch until repaired and recovered; nothing leaks. A hopper holding nutrients refuses to be moved or dismantled. Kiosk nutrients cost the same per kilogram as bulk charges and packets, and nothing sells back. The contents are the crop model's single aggregate nutrient figure.

groups.title: Groundwork Bulk Nutrient Charge
groups.function: One physical 500 g dry formulated nutrient charge for gradual selected W2 dosing.
groups.use: Put in the W2 inventory; the W2 takes nutrients from it by itself while running. Explicitly choose the distribute-and-replace standing order to authorize crew replacement from the approved input store.
groups.find: Agriculture merchants in finite lots of eight, or one charge per independent station Bulk supplies purchase into a selected W2 inventory. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Same aggregate formulation value per kg as existing nutrients. Dedicated bulk nutrient packet artwork, localized name and measured mass distinguish it. No water carrier or new chemical assay. Remaining mass/value decrease; empty charges vanish. No Repair/Restore. Bulk charges support storage stacks of three individual objects. Split off one before dosing; partially depleted charges retain their own contents.

PhobosFramework.intro: Framework supplies shared services rather than a set of standalone machines. Since 0.57.0 it also owns the two lines every Phobos mod shares, the gas line and the process-water line, so any mod's machines can pipe to any mod's stores. Repairs on every Phobos machine use up their parts, as the game's own repairs do; the retired spent service parts are listed for older saves. Construction menus, machinery controls and the opt-in Scope recorder are interfaces, not additional inventory objects. Crew standing orders are opt-in; see [crew work, training and time-skips](crew-automation.md) for eligible work, approved stores, resource limits and resuming industrial and exterior work. Compact controls, unsaved settings and object selection are explained in the [control-panel guide](control-panel-guide.md). In selection fields, Locate opens a temporary marked ship view; Clear is a draft change that requires Apply. Pick on ship marks eligible objects and Escape restores the panel and view.

groups.title: Spent Service Parts
groups.function: Legacy, retired in Framework 0.74.0: worn parts that Phobos repairs used to leave behind. Repairs now use up their parts, as the game's own repairs do.
groups.use: Nothing to do: any left in a save are removed when the ship loads, with one crew-log line.
groups.find: Only in saves from before Framework 0.74.0. Nothing makes them any more.
groups.notes: The definition stays registered only so older saves load them before they are removed.

groups.title: Gas line
groups.function: Sealed Fennmark gas line joining gas stores and the machines that fill or draw from them: Manufacturing's stores, V4, X2, K2, AX-2, LC-3, SA-3, P1, L2 and A2, and Shipbreaker's T2 for methane. Every gas store and gas-using machine the line runs under or right beside joins one network, and touching equipment joins without it. It has its own lane, so it shares tiles with other lines. Its retained waste is what dismantling leaves.
groups.use: Lay it through INSTALL > HVAC on intact floor until it runs under or right beside each machine and store, on any side. Link choices say why a store aboard is not offered. A damaged segment breaks the network there until repaired. To take it up, right-click it and choose Vent gas line; the run closes until Return line to service.
groups.find: Sold new at the K-Leg supply kiosk and fixer, San Diego Halvorson and the Venus scrap kiosk in lots of 128. Ordinary supply. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: Moved from Manufacturing to Framework in 0.57.0 with its saved identity, name, price and bills unchanged, so it no longer needs Manufacturing installed. Since Framework 0.63.0 it holds a few grams of gas a tile, a mix when several gases share it, filled from its stores; a damaged segment lets its gas into the room (hydrogen overboard), and a segment holding gas cannot be taken up until vented. Pressure drop is neglected. When an oxygen store and a fuel store share one line, the stores' panels and the crew log say so; nothing is blocked. The retained waste is terminal.

groups.title: Process water line
groups.function: Sealed line for process water between water tanks (Framework's Rivetline silos, and Ship's Water 0.16.1 tanks when installed) and the machines that draw or make water: Manufacturing's V4, X2, K2, LC-3 and SA-3, Shipbreaker's T2 and Agriculture's W2 intake and racks. Every water tank and water-using machine the line runs under or right beside joins one network, and touching equipment joins without it. It has its own blue lane, so it shares tiles with other lines.
groups.use: Lay it through INSTALL > HVAC on intact floor until it runs under or right beside each machine and tank, on any side. Then link the machine to the tank on its Control Panel; the list shows how each tank is reached. To take it up, right-click it and choose Drain line into canister with a drain canister carried or within two tiles; the run closes until Return line to service.
groups.find: Sold new at the K-Leg supply kiosk and fixer, San Diego Halvorson and the Venus scrap kiosk in lots of 128. Ordinary supply. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: New in Framework 0.57.0. Process grade only: it never joins drinking water. Since Framework 0.63.0 it holds about 0.49 kg of water a tile, filled from its tanks (and, since Framework 0.65.0, from Ship’s Water drinking tanks above the crew reserve), and a segment holding water cannot be taken up until drained. Irrigation conduit is a separate line for the W2's racks. The retained waste is terminal.

groups.title: Rivetline conveyor belt
groups.function: Conveyor belt for loose items between machines, collectors and stores. A run of intact belt that lies on or beside two pieces of equipment joins them for Phobos Shipbreaker's item routes: a collector fed by a D4, the reclaimer's feed, the F6's input and output, and D4 or R4 storage output. Equipment within one tile of each other needs no belt.
groups.use: Lay it through INSTALL > MISC on intact floor, tile by tile, from beside the sender to beside the receiver: a machine's footprint, a collector's inboard tiles or the F6's input or output marker. Then link and start the route; its status says whether it runs by conveyor belt or touching. Belts share tiles with pipe and line, in the lowest lane.
groups.find: Sold new at the K-Leg supply kiosk and fixer, San Diego Halvorson and the Venus scrap kiosk in lots of 128. Ordinary supply. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: New in Framework 0.61.0. Items never ride it: each still moves straight from one machine to the other in one checked transfer, powered and paid for by the machine that sends or receives it. A belt cut, damaged or taken up stops the route until you mend it and resume. Dismantling returns the whole segment as retained waste, which is terminal.

groups.title: Rivetline D20 drain canister
groups.function: A portable 20 litre lined can for draining lines: about 20 kg of water or 36.7 kg of sulfuric acid, one liquid at a time. It carries a drained line’s contents back to a tank.
groups.use: Carry it, or leave it on the deck within two tiles of the line, then right-click an installed water or acid line and choose Drain line into canister. Haul the full canister into the inventory of a tank that holds the same liquid (a Rivetline water silo, or an acid tank’s canister rack) and it pours in, leaving the empty can there. The game’s own Haul orders or a hauling mod such as Common Sense move it like any cargo.
groups.find: Sold new at the K-Leg supply kiosk and fixer, San Diego Halvorson, the Venus scrap kiosk and the regional supply kiosks in lots of 16. Ordinary supply. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks, at any standing.
groups.notes: New in Framework 0.63.0. It never stacks, since each canister records what it holds; its weight is the 3 kg can plus that liquid. Gas lines are vented instead, since they hold only grams. No repair or dismantling. Its sprite is PixelLab art since Framework 0.65.0.

groups.title: S2, S3, S4 and S5 Process Water Silos
groups.function: Passive vessels holding process water as a saved record, shared by every Phobos mod: the 2 x 2 S2 holds 400 kg, the 3 x 3 S3 1,000 kg, the 4 x 4 S4 1,960 kg and the 5 x 5 S5 3,330 kg. Bigger silos hold more for less per kilogram of capacity; a full silo weighs its housing plus its water. Each has a four-cell service rack for manual work.
groups.use: Install through APPS; no power. Machines reach a silo by touching it or along a process-water line that runs under or right beside both, and several machines can share one. Fill at a station under Bulk supplies, from a linked machine such as a T2, or (with Ship's Water 0.16.1) draw from the drinking-water tanks above the crew reserve; send water to the waste tanks for the Recycler. With Agriculture, crew can load 5 kg irrigation charges from its inventory, drain it or keep it topped up by standing order. Set Keep in reserve on the panel or C1; a refuelling kiosk buys water above the reserve back at 4.50 cr/kg under Bulk supplies. After damage, repair and Recover trapped water; a protected silo offers Accept contents as they are. See [the silo guide](shipbreaker-bulk-silos.md).
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below. No fabrication recipe. The S3 may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; the S2, S4 and S5 do not. See the exact offers below. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Warm standing.
groups.notes: Moved from Shipbreaker to Framework in Framework 0.58.0 with their ids, saved records and names unchanged; the S2 is new, and Agriculture's retired R3, R4 and R5 reservoirs convert to the S3, S4 and S5 on load. Process water only: never a drinking-water tank, never fuel. Uninstalling carries the water with the loose silo; Dismantle is refused while water remains, and removal is refused while the silo is protected. Water is lost with a destroyed silo (logged). The S2's sprite is a recorded reduction of the S3's.

PhobosManufacturing.intro: Phobos Manufacturing refines what the crew mines and runs the first chemistry aboard: the Fennmark V4 Volatiles Refinery, the X2 Chemical Processor (water electrolysis), the K2 Sabatier Reactor, the Tolvane AX-2 Ammonia Cracker, the Lixivar LC-3 Leach and Crystallise Unit and SA-3 Sulfuric Acid Plant, hydrogen, methane, oxygen, nitrogen, carbon dioxide and ammonia stores and Lixivar sulfuric acid tanks in three sizes each, the P1 RCS Propellant Manifold, the L2 Canister Filling Station and the A2 Cabin Air Regulator, with nickel-iron ingots and carbon stock as raw stock, the LC-3's fertiliser salts and intermediates, the SA-3's phosphoric acid flask, eight terminal remainders and four minable chunks. Every charge conserves mass and is recorded with its chemistry and sources in [the refinery design record](development/manufacturing-refinery-and-chemistry.md); operating instructions are in [the player guide](manufacturing-player-guide.md). Machines are purchase-only; ores and chunks are mined, never bought; bulk oxygen, nitrogen and carbon dioxide are sold only through the station Bulk supplies view. The machines are late-game plant, priced among the game's own radars, heavy lift rotors and missile launchers; they carry the game's high-salvage mark, need component repairs and are rare world finds. See [the equipment economy](equipment-economy.md#manufacturing-011-late-game-plant).

groups.title: V4 Volatiles Refinery
groups.function: A 4 x 4 electric hearth and drying retort. One charge at a time: hydrates (10 kg) to 1 kg of water and three gangue; clay hydrates to 2 kg of water and an 8 kg anhydrous residue; an ammonium salt crust to 0.955 kg of ammonia for a linked ammonia store, 0.505 kg of water, 1.235 kg of CO2 into the room and a spent salt cake; carbon ore to five carbon stock, 1 kg of water, one gangue and 1 kg of CO2, CO and smoke breathed into the room; meteoric iron to four nickel-iron ingots, one gangue and 1 kg of slag; an LC-3 leached residue (6.8 kg) to 0.26 kg of carbon dioxide for a linked carbon dioxide store and a 6.54 kg calcined residue; with Shipbreaker, four nickel-iron ingots and one carbon stock to four steel ingots and a melt remainder.
groups.use: Install through APPS, connect power, link a water vessel (S3 or R3 within one tile) on its panel or C1 for the water charges an ammonia store within one tile for the salt crust and a carbon dioxide store within one tile for a leached residue, load one charge into its feed (the Inventory opens the tray and the feed), then Start. 24 kW while working; part of it warms the room. Run a scrubber in its room for the carbon and salt crust charges. See [the player guide](manufacturing-player-guide.md).
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below; it is late-game equipment with late-game prices. No fabrication recipe. About one engineering-loot roll in twenty yields a Fennmark machine, usually broken; see the exact offers below. The K-Leg fixer buys it back intact and the Venus scrap kiosk intact or broken. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Trusted standing.
groups.notes: A melt (nickel-iron or steel) left waiting for a cool room longer than its own run freezes into slag. A charge that was running carries on after a reload. A steel charge saved before Shipbreaker is removed is kept, never overwritten. Empty the tray by hand.

groups.title: X2 Chemical Processor
groups.function: A 2 x 2 water electrolysis cell. Each one-hour cycle at 6 kW splits 1.125 kg of water into 1.000 kg of oxygen and 0.125 kg of hydrogen (2 H2O to 2 H2 + O2).
groups.use: Install through APPS within one tile of a water vessel and an H2 store, connect power, link both on its panel or C1, choose an installed O2 canister within one tile (or leave it on cabin air), then Start. It runs only while every output has room; a full canister or store makes it wait.
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below; it is late-game equipment with late-game prices. No fabrication recipe. About one engineering-loot roll in twenty yields a Fennmark machine, usually broken; see the exact offers below. The K-Leg fixer buys it back intact and the Venus scrap kiosk intact or broken. Also sold for scrip at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks; they ask Trusted standing.
groups.notes: Oxygen into the cabin raises the oxygen partial pressure, which raises the game's own fire chance. It carries on after a reload if it was running, with the held water and cycle energy kept. Cancel forfeits the cycle's energy, never the water.

groups.title: H2, H3 and H4 Hydrogen Stores
groups.function: Passive pressurised stores for electrolysis hydrogen (24, 59 and 115 kg), kept as a kilogram record (hydrogen has no game gas). Three sizes: small 2 x 2, medium 3 x 3 and large 4 x 4, each one tile wider and holding more for less per kilogram.
groups.use: Install through APPS within one tile of an X2 or an AX-2 ammonia cracker (which fill it) and, for the Sabatier stage, a K2 (which draws from it); link them from those machines. Vent overboard or pour into another store of the same gas (within one tile or along a gas line) from its panel or C1. Repair damage at once and empty it before uninstalling. It can also feed the RCS through a P1 manifold (within one tile or by gas line; switched off until you turn it on).
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below; it is late-game equipment with late-game prices, and the bigger sizes cost less per kilogram held. No fabrication recipe.
